description: Validate a BIC (ISO 9362): structure, country code, test-BIC flag, bank and branch parts, and the bank name(s) where known. Example: 'EBILAEAD'. Response: result plus data_confidence (high = check-digit algorithm from a public specification; medium = community-documented checksum or pattern-only; low = structure only), estimated_items[], sources[], data_version and a disclaimer (structural validation only — never proof that an identifier is issued or belongs to someone).
